ValidationRule.description: Validation to restrict user to mark a quote as primary on insert if Primary Product is WO/WS
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.QuoteValidation__c ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) ) , ISNEW(), SBQQ__Primary__c, OR( ISPICKVAL(NSP_Opportunity_Primary_Product__c, "WO"), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Opportunity_Primary_Product__c, "WS") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quote cannot be marked as Primary on creation for WO and WS.
